rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: DreamFactory MCP Server enables AI assistants like Claude to directly query your databases through DreamFactory's auto-generated REST APIs. This Node.js server implements the Model Context Protocol (MCP), allowing natural language database interactions while maintaining enterprise-grade security. Connect multiple databases simultaneously, run complex queries using conversational language, and build AI-powered applications without writing custom integrations. Perfect for demos, prototypes, and production systems that need secure AI-to-database communication.
